attchmntText: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call held on November 02, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR285.45 crores and profit after tax of INR63.33 crore for the quarter. The consolidated order book exceeded INR2,000 crores. New manufacturing facilities in Sangli and Turkey commenced operations. The company is preparing for a proposed Qualified Institutional Placement targeting November, subject to regulatory approvals. Capital allocation priorities include completing the acquisition of Win-Win Specialty Insulators, expanding manufacturing capacity, and strengthening working capital.

attchmntText: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited filed a statement regarding deviations in IPO fund utilization for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company confirms no deviation in the use of proceeds. Funds raised amount to 858.696 Crore on 20th February 2025. The Audit Committee reviewed the statement. Capital expenditure shows a delay in deployment. The original allocation was 27.22 Crore with 22.23 Crore utilized. A board resolution passed on October 31, 2026, states unutilized portions will be fully utilized within the next two quarters. Funding for inorganic growth and general corporate purposes also shows delayed deployment. The original allocation was 61.18 Crore with 57.73 Crore utilized. This resolution also applies to these funds. Issue-related expenses show an increase from 19.61 Crore to 22.94 Crore utilized. The monitoring agency is Brickwork Ratings India Private Limited. The statement is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange. The report was issued by Brickwork Ratings India Private Limited regarding the utilization of proceeds from the company's Initial Public Offer. The total amount received from the IPO was 858.696 Crore. This comprised 224.999 Crore from the fresh issue of 5,294,100 equity shares at Rs. 425 per share, and 633.696 Crore from the offer for sale of 14,910,500 equity shares at Rs. 425 per share. The report details that 7.21 Crore was invested in the Axis Bank Monitoring Account. The document is also available on the company website at www.qualitypower.com.
